description: Get quarterly or annual financial statements for a company from SEC 10-K/10-Q filings: revenue, net income, EPS, margins, operating cash flow, cash, capex, free cash flow, buybacks, dividends, investing/financing cash flow, total assets/liabilities and debt ratios. capex, stock_repurchase (buybacks) and dividends_paid are each normally a positive cash payment (USD); negative values are passed through as filed or derived; a negative capex makes free_cash_flow null. free_cash_flow = operating_cashflow - capex only when both are reported and capex >= 0, otherwise null (never computed from a missing or negative value). cash_and_equivalents excludes short-term investments; long_term_debt is us-gaap LongTermDebt, which includes the current portion. Plan limits: the Free plan and keyless access return only the latest quarterly statement; annual statements and earlier quarters require Pro (a request for them returns an explicit plan-limit error, never 'no data'). structuredContent carries the exact reported values.
name: get_stock_financials

capex.description: Payments to acquire property, plant and equipment: normally a positive cash payment (USD); negative values are passed through as filed or derived and make free_cash_flow null

cash_and_equivalents.description: Cash and cash equivalents at period end, USD; excludes short-term investments

dividends_paid.description: Dividends paid: normally a positive cash payment (USD); negative values are passed through as filed or derived

financing_cashflow.description: Net cash from financing activities, USD, signed (negative = net cash used)

free_cash_flow.description: operating_cashflow - capex, exact; only when both are non-null and capex >= 0, otherwise null (never computed from a missing or negative value)

investing_cashflow.description: Net cash from investing activities, USD, signed (negative = net cash used)

long_term_debt.description: us-gaap LongTermDebt: total long-term debt INCLUDING the current portion (not the balance-sheet noncurrent line), USD

revenue.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

stock_repurchase.description: Payments for repurchase of common stock (buybacks): normally a positive cash payment (USD); negative values are passed through as filed or derived

plan_limit.description: The Free/keyless plan limits ko.io applied to this answer (null for paid callers)

plan_note.description: Set when the caller's plan limited which periods were returned
